en: A vintage black‑and‑white studio photograph shows two young children standing side by side, dressed in elaborate traditional Southeast Asian ceremonial attire. They wear patterned long sarongs, fitted jackets, and are adorned with multiple layers of necklaces, belts, bracelets, and hair ornaments with flowers. One child rests an arm on the other's shoulder. The background includes a draped curtain and a decorative pedestal with an ornate vase or urn, suggesting a formal portrait setting. A small printed reference number appears in the lower right margin.
